items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Archie used to come in the club.

ctx.x: He worked with Arthur Godfrey for a while. You know who I'm talking about? (Snaps fingers.) The publisher? Wrote more tunes, what was that? Hmmm, hmmm, hmmmmm, made millions, guy with tunes, and he's arranger here. He -- Martin Block. Not Martin Block.
I remember Archie Bleyer, if that's the guy you're talking -- Archie Bleyer?
